title: Kuraray
summary: Japanese chemical group supplying battery binders, films and water-treatment membranes.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Kuraray makes polyvinyl alcohol, battery binders, optical films, synthetic leather and water-treatment membranes. Its binder materials help hold electrodes together, and its optical films serve display polarisers. The group is expanding into battery and environmental materials.

Technology Exposure

  • Battery binders and separators
  • Optical and polariser films
  • Water-treatment membranes

What To Watch

  • Battery-materials growth
  • Display film demand
  • Vinyl-acetate feedstock costs

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
